query_encoding: Query parameters go through Faraday's default nested-params encoding: an array becomes repeated name[]=value pairs, which is why Stardance's comment says Rack keeps commas inside array elements (line 136), and true, false and integers become their plain strings. Hackatime ignores parameters it doesn't know, so the _t cache-buster has no effect on the answer.
